title: Change model, mode and effort by clicking them in the Claude screen's foot
notes:
The foot of every Claude screen reads e.g. 'Opus 5.5 · auto mode · default effort' (screenshot from the user, 2026-11-08). Today they change only by key: Alt+M walks the models, the permission-mode key walks the modes, and effort is the /effort search sheet (chat-screen-dispatch.ts). A click on them does nothing.

Change: each of the three is clickable. A click opens the same kind of sheet /effort opens, listing that setting's choices with the current one selected, walked with the arrow keys and taken with Enter; a click on a row selects it and then does what Enter does (conventions-rule-1). Model lists MODELS (chat-view.ts), mode lists the modes the key walks (auto included), effort reuses the /effort sheet. The keys stay as they are. Hover shows they are clickable (cursor, a subtle underline or colour), and the foot's layout does not shift.

Decisions (which list a click opens, what is selected first) in a small module with a test (workflow-rule-2). help.ts's Claude screen blurb mentions the click if the blurb names these keys (keys-rule-2). Docs: chat README, history.
